source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Radiator and Grille, p.13-5

procedures.title: Radiator and shroud layout (Corvette)
steps: Refer to figure 5 in the manual for the assembled position of the radiator and shroud for each Corvette engine combination.
notes: Figure 5 shows four arrangements: 327 V8 without C60 (with a separate supply tank, view A); L88 427 V8 (no shroud); 327 V8 with C60 and 427 V8 except L88 without C60; 427 V8 with C60.
The figure marks a .75" dimension at the fan within the shroud on the shrouded versions and a 2.0" dimension at the fan on the L88 version.
